C0503.title: College Students' National Subsidy Quotas Targeted by Scalpers, Mass Proxy Ordering to Exploit Platform Discounts
C0503.summary: Scalpers specializing in bulk purchasing are exploiting e-commerce platform subsidies and consumer vouchers by recruiting individuals to place proxy orders, circumventing one-time-per-account limits. These scalpers recruit online and on campuses to place orders, then resell the goods to physical stores for profit.
